page.overview:
Who is Matazo?

Matazo is a relatively tall man of stocky build with short gray hair, and small stubble on his chin. Physically, he appeared to be in his 50s in age, and was generally seen with a kind expression his face.

As a newly transformed demon, Matazo gains two short horns on his forehead, his canines morphed into more prominent fangs, and his nail became pointed talon-like claws. His face appeared more monstrous and feral and his veins became more prominent across his body.

During his daughter’s childhood, Matazo was shown to be a loving, but awkward father to his daughter. This was mainly due to him having difficulty bonding with her after her mother’s death. As shown, Matazo was initially hesitant to train his daughter in hunting due to initially believing that it was not a profession fit for a woman, but eventually gave in when his friends revealed that Yae simply wanted to spend time with him and bond with him through hunting.

After becoming a demon, Matazo was shown to have become extremely feral and had lost nearly all reason and rationality. As shown where he had immediately violently killed his fellow hunters and devoured them. However, despite becoming a near rabid animal, Matazo still retains his strong love for his daughter, as shown where he recognized her after his first frenzy and ran away from her to avoid eating her as well. Later after she tracked him down in the mountain, Matazo was able to say her name as he tried to eat her.
